nav.title: Isikhungo sokuxhumana se-AI
nav.subtitle: Usizo lwamalimi amanengi nokudluliselwa okulawulwa emuntwini.

customer.title: Thoma inkhulumo
customer.consentText: Ngiyavuma ukuthi le nkhulumo ingasetshenzwa ngumhlinzeki we-AI. Imibhalo iyavikelwa ngaphambi kokugcinwa.
customer.setupHint: Akukhonakali kuze umphathi ahlele isihluthulelo nomhlinzeki we-AI.
customer.chatEmpty: Imilayezo ibonakala lapha. Imisebenzi ye-AI yiseluleko kuphela; akukho ukukhokha namkha ukutjhentjha i-akhawunti.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Ilizwi lesiphequluli lithunyelwa kumhlinzeki; i-OpsCore ayikuboni ukuthi igcina ilizwi.
customer.voiceRequirement: Ilizwi lesiphequluli lidinga i-HTTPS, imakrofoni, imvumo, imodeli ye-Realtime nesihluthulelo. Akusilo ucingo.

queue.title: Umugca wokudlulisela
queue.description: Inkhulumo eyingozi namkha ecelile umuntu ibonakala lapha. Umugca kukucela, akusiko ukuxhumana.
queue.replyStorageNote: Iimpendulo zabantu zivikelwe futhi zibonakala emibhalweni.

boundaries.title: Imikhawulo yemisebenzi
boundaries.automateBody: Ukuphendula kokuqala ngamalimi amanengi, ukucacisa, ukuhlola ingozi nokugcina imibhalo.
boundaries.humanBody: Ukucela umuntu, ukungathembi, ingozi enkulu, imithetho engekho, indaba engakalungiswa, isikhalo sefihlo.
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP, WhatsApp, i-imeyili, ucingo, CRM nokuqinisekisa amalimi kudinga umhlinzeki wangempela nemihlolo.

messages.qualificationNotice: Alikho ilimi eligunyazithewko kuze imihlolo yemibhalo, i-ASR, i-TTS nelizwi iphele.
messages.configOk: Ukuhlela kukhona. Ukuxhumana nekhwalithi yelimi kudinga imihlolo yangempela.
messages.conversationCreated: Inkhulumo evikelekileko yenziwe. Ikhwalithi yelimi ayikagunyazwa.
messages.handoffQueued: Ukudlulisela emuntwini kufakiwe emgceni ({reason}). Kukucela, akusiko ukuxhumana.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Ukuphendula kwe-AI akukapheleli. Akukho msebenzi owenziweko. Ungacela umuntu.
messages.apiUnavailable: I-API yokuxhumana ayitholakalanga. Ngena ku-OpsCore bese uvuselela lelikhasi.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Ukudlulisela kufakiwe emgceni ({reason}). Umugca awubonisi ukuthi umsebenzi ukhona.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Ukudlulisela kufakiwe emgceni. Inkhulumo ye-AI iyema; ucingo aluhleliwe.
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Umhlinzeki we-Realtime ubonise iphutha. Misa ilizwi, hlola ukuhlela, bese uphinda.
messages.voiceActive: Inkhulumo yelizwi iyasebenza. Cela umuntu nanyana nini; lokhu kwenza umugca, akusilo ucingo.
